hero.title: Anderson Vanegas
hero.verdict: Release-ready SQA engineer. 6+ years, 0 critical escapes.
hero.bio: Staff SQA Engineer at Boston Dynamics, where I break robots on purpose so they don’t break by accident. Six years of manual rigor, now compiled into Python tooling, Appium suites and CI pipelines that report back before anyone has to ask.

rows.value: Manual to automation, and not looking back

suitesSection.title: Work history, executed.
suitesSection.lede: Each role is a suite. Each accomplishment is a test case. All of them ran in production, which is the only environment that counts.

environmentSection.title: Tools in the matrix.
environmentSection.lede: Everything configured, versioned and used in anger. No “familiar with” padding.

qualitySection.title: This site, tested like everything else.
qualitySection.lede: Every deploy runs Lighthouse, axe and Playwright in CI. If a check goes red, it doesn’t ship. It would be awkward otherwise.

signoff.title: Approved for release.
signoff.lede: Hiring for QA, test automation or someone who asks “what happens if…” before it happens? Let’s talk.

knownIssue.label: WON’T FIX
knownIssue.text: Responds to “quick question” with a reproducible test case. Severity: low. Frequency: always.
